title: Serving runtime daily scratchpad - 2026-03-05
content:
2026-03-05 — daily scratchpad
Context: personal notes for serving-runtime work. Mostly triage + perf TODOs. Quick logs.

Today goals:
- triage SRV-1423 kv-cache leak repro + mitigate
- benchmark fused attention kernel variant on A100
- follow up with infra on kernel rollout schedule
- prepare short postmortem notes for customer incident (2026-03-04)

Bug triage:
- SRV-1423: intermittent OOM on long-chat sessions
  - observed: kv cache grows > expected after 1k tokens
  - suspected: stale references in KVCacheMap when session cleanup races with cache persist
  - repro: script in /tmp/repro_kv_leak.py (see linked PR)
  - next: add extra refcount logging + quick fix to session cleanup (PR 789)
- SRV-1418: degraded throughput when batching high variance seq_len
  - notes: current batching heuristic over-batches short requests
  - idea: dynamic max_batch_size per bucket based on 95th pct seq_len

Perf TODOs:
- Run compare: fused-attn-v2 vs baseline on 2xA100, seq_len=2048, batch=1..8
  - metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU mem
  - schedule: run overnight -> results in /results/fused-attn-2026-03-05.csv
- Kernel tuning:
  - check l2 tiling params for matmul kernel
  - try FP16 with scaled softmax vs FP32 reference
- Batching:
  - implement quick heuristic to prioritize short requests in real-time queue (pseudo: weight=1/seq_len)
  - test percentiles impact on p95

Notes to self:
- Remember to add unit test for KVCacheMap cleanup; edge case when session id reused.
- Talk to Priya about adding more observability: per-session cache size histogram
- Ping Alex about rolling kernel flags behind feature flag

Open questions:
- Is the observed leak only on private deployments? We saw it on dedicated stack too.
- Should we backport quick fix to 2026-02 release branch?

Quick links:
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/789
- Jira: SRV-1423, SRV-1418
- Repro harness: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/repro-scripts#kv-leak

TODO (today):
- [ ] add refcount logs and deploy to staging
- [ ] run fused-attn-v2 perf sweep
- [ ] write brief to cs team about incident and mitigation
- [ ] add unit tests for session cleanup
- [ ] schedule sync with infra (Alex) 11:00

End.
